examples.title: Build and configure a Merge
examples.code:
# Create two source nodes so this example runs on its own.
foreground = nuke.createNode("Constant")
background = nuke.createNode("Constant")

# Merge A over B.
merge = nuke.createNode("Merge2")
merge.setInput(0, foreground)
merge.setInput(1, background)
merge["operation"].setValue("over")

# Change the same Merge to a Plus operation.
merge["operation"].setValue("plus")

# Restrict both inputs to RGB channels.
merge["Achannels"].setValue("rgb")
merge["Bchannels"].setValue("rgb")
